def digitSum(s):
    # Validate the input string to ensure it only contains printable ASCII characters
    if not all(ord(char) < 128 and char.isprintable() for char in s):
        return "Input string contains non-printable ASCII characters"
    
    # Iterate through the input string and filter out the upper characters
    upper_chars = [char for char in s if char.isupper()]
    
    # Calculate the ASCII codes of the filtered upper characters and sum up the ASCII codes
    total_sum = sum(ord(char) for char in upper_chars)
    
    return total_sum
